title: 第4章凡骨第5章入道第6章燃骨
slug: 天行健君子以自强不息
content_zh:
【剧情回顾】
黑石铁矿，付之一炬。
沈青引燃火油罐，以身殉仇，和赵家百年根基同归于尽。火场废墟翻遍数次，尸骨无存，生死成谜。林天行拼死带出一只粗布包袱，内里是四十七张满血手印的卖身契、一本写满肮脏交易的黑账本、一叠官商勾结的私密信件。
他在天青城菜市口，将所有罪证张贴上墙。围观百姓从数十人暴涨至数百人，直接堵死半条长街。赵家打手赶来撕榜时，为时已晚；城中书生早已手抄扩散，半日之内，全城皆知赵家恶行。
府衙被汹涌民怨裹挟，只能佯装彻查。赵世杰罢免主簿之职，赵世昌连夜逃窜避祸。那四十七张血淋淋的卖身契，成了压垮赵家的最后一击。四十七条底层人命铁证如山，纵使赵家家财万贯，也堵不住满城百姓的口。
可沈青，终究没能回来。
众人只在一号冶炼炉内壁，发现一层诡异的暗金光泽。当夜值夜官差誓死作证，炉膛深处，传来过清晰沉稳的心跳声。
火海落幕后，林天行陷入一场极致绵长的昏睡。月光落上他的手背，淡金色纹路在皮下悄然勾勒、缓缓蔓延。万丈地心之下，沉睡万古的盘古精血稳步上浮，一场颠覆天地的觉醒，已然悄然开启。
---
林天行再度睁眼，已是两日后的午后。
细碎阳光穿透破败窗纸，落在脸上，暖得虚假。
他凝望着虫蛀斑驳的房梁，失神良久。混沌的思绪一点点回笼：矿场大火、拼死取证、沈青的决绝、无数枉死的矿工……所有惨烈过往，尽数涌上心头。
浑身酸胀沉重，像是被千斤土石碾过，骨缝里透着挥之不去的疲惫。他撑着床板坐起，骤然察觉异样。身上竟换了一身干净粗布衣裳，矿场经年累积的燎泡、鞭痕结痂大多脱落，露出粉嫩的新生皮肉。
“醒了？”
门口传来母亲沙哑温和的声音。
她端着热粥缓步走入，发丝梳得整齐，补丁衣衫洗得洁净。眼底依旧带着哭过的红痕，神志却彻底清明。缠了家中许久的疯癫，终于彻底褪去了。
“娘，你……”
“我好了。”母亲落座床边，递过热粥，“你昏睡两天，周大夫来了三次。他说你身子亏空太甚，必须静养。别说话，先喝粥。”
碗里是软糯小米粥，卧着一枚完整鸡蛋，撒了少许细盐。
对贫民巷的人家来说，这是逢年过节都未必能吃上的好物。林天行捧着热碗，鼻尖骤然发酸。他早已记不清，自己多久没尝过鸡蛋的滋味了。依稀还是去年端午，那时父亲未残、母亲未疯，家里尚有几分烟火暖意。

他小口吞咽，吃得极慢。温热的粥食滑入腹间，压下了满腔翻涌的酸涩。
“爹去哪了？”
“去衙门作证了。”母亲接过空碗，语气平静，“奴籍废除、赵家罪证曝光后，官府重启旧案。你爹当年被赵家打伤的冤案，也被翻了出来。”
“他身子扛得住？”林天行眉心微蹙。
“拄着拐杖去的，有邻居陪着，出不了事。”
林天行颔首，又急忙追问矿场众人的下落：“老孙头、大柱他们，都逃出来了吧？”
母亲沉默一瞬，语气沉了下来：“孙瘸子、李大柱、赵寡妇都平安脱身。唯独老孙头，没出来。”
“没出来？”
“火势最凶的时候，他明明已经冲到侧门，逃出生天了。”母亲声音低哑，“没人明白缘由，他突然扭头冲回火海，呜呜嘶吼着，谁都拦不住。最后，彻底被烈火吞噬。”
林天行闭上双眼。
那个失语二十年的老人，瞬间清晰浮现。蹲在棚屋门口，用碎石支起破瓦罐煮野菜汤；自己重伤高烧、昏迷不醒时，也是那双粗糙的手，一勺一勺喂水续命，硬生生把他从鬼门关拉了回来。
二十年矿场奴役，割舌致残，受尽践踏、从无尊严。
谁能读懂他最后的抉择？
是舍不得半生唯一的旧物？是骤然得自由，反而茫然无措？还是真的活够了？苦难碾碎了所有期许，对他而言，死亡或许才是唯一的解脱。
林天行睁眼，压下眼底酸涩，不再多问。胸腔里沉甸甸的，堵得人发闷。
他起身下地，腿脚短暂发软，走几步便稳了力道。扫视屋内，他心头微讶。墙角堆着粮食与干柴，灶梁上挂着半刀腊肉，这般物资，放在从前，他家过年都不敢奢望。
“这些东西哪来的？”
“不清楚。”母亲摇头，“昨日清晨开门，东西就摆在门口，没有字条。巷里好几户穷苦人家，都莫名收到了物资。有人得米，有人得鱼，有人得新鞋。送东西的人从不露面，放下就走。”
林天行愣了愣，瞬间通透。
全城皆知赵家倒台，皆知是他顶着生死风险，撕开了权贵的遮羞布。这些悄悄送来东西的人，都是在市井里讨生活的寻常百姓。他们护不住公道，却愿用自己的一点心意，来撑一撑这个为他们出头的少年。

他们不愿留下名姓，怕惹上是非牵连；却还是悄悄送来了。这点点细碎的暖意，看似卑微，却滚烫得像一团火。
他走到门口，望着巷中往来的街坊。有人瞥见他，只是轻轻点头示意。没有多余的寒暄，也没有刻意的追捧，只有同走过苦日子的人，才懂的那份无声默契。彼此熬过同样的苦，无需多言，尽数懂得。
这一刻，林天行彻底笃定。沈青的命，没有白丢。
content_en:
【Plot review】
Blackstone Iron Mine was burned to the ground.
Shen Qing ignited the fire oil tank and died for revenge, destroying the century-old foundation of the Zhao family. The ruins of the fire scene were searched several times, but no bones were left, and life and death were a mystery. Lin Tianxing desperately brought out a coarse cloth baggage, which contained forty-seven deeds of prostitution filled with bloody handprints, a black ledger full of dirty transactions, and a stack of private letters about collusion between officials and businessmen.
He posted all the evidence on the wall at Caishikou, Tianqing City. The number of onlookers surged from dozens to hundreds, blocking half of the street. When the Zhao family's thugs came to tear up the list, it was too late; the scholars in the city had already spread the copy, and within half a day, the whole city knew about the Zhao family's evil deeds.
The government office was coerced by the surging public complaints and could only pretend to conduct a thorough investigation. Zhao Shijie dismissed him from the post of chief registrar, and Zhao Shichang fled overnight to avoid disaster. Those forty-seven bloody contracts of betrayal became the final blow to the Zhao family. The forty-seven lives of people at the bottom are irrefutable. Even if the Zhao family has a huge fortune, they cannot stop the people in the city from talking about it.
But Shen Qing failed to come back after all.
Everyone only found a strange dark gold luster on the inner wall of the No. 1 smelting furnace. When the night officer on duty swore to death to testify, a clear and steady heartbeat could be heard from deep in the furnace.
After the sea of ​​​​fire ended, Lin Tianxing fell into an extremely long sleep. The moonlight fell on the back of his hand, and pale golden lines were quietly outlined and spread slowly under the skin. Beneath the center of the earth, the essence and blood of Pangu, which had been sleeping for eternity, was steadily rising, and an awakening that would subvert the world had quietly begun.
---
Lin Tianxing opened his eyes again, it was already the afternoon two days later.
Fragments of sunlight penetrated the broken window paper and fell on the face, making it falsely warm.
He stared at the moth-eaten beams, lost in thought for a long time. Chaotic thoughts came back little by little: the fire in the mine, the desperate effort to collect evidence, Shen Qing's determination, countless miners who died in vain...all the tragic past came to mind.
His whole body was sore and heavy, as if he had been run over by thousands of pounds of earth and rocks, and there was lingering fatigue in his bones. He sat up and propped himself up on the bed, suddenly noticing something strange. The body was actually changed into a pair of clean coarse cloth clothes. Most of the blisters, whip marks and scabs accumulated in the mine over the years fell off, revealing the tender new skin.
"Are you awake?"
Mother's hoarse and gentle voice came from the door.
She walked in slowly with hot porridge in her hands, her hair neatly combed, and her patched clothes washed clean. His eyes were still red from crying, but his mind was completely clear. The madness that had plagued the family for a long time finally faded away completely.
"Mom, you..."
"I'm fine." Mother sat beside the bed and handed over the hot porridge, "You were in coma for two days, and Doctor Zhou came three times. He said that your body was too weak and you must rest. Don't talk and drink porridge first."
In the bowl is soft and glutinous millet porridge, with a whole egg lying on it and sprinkled with a little salt.
For the people in the slums, this is a good food that they may not be able to eat during the holidays. Lin Tianxing held the hot bowl, and the tip of his nose suddenly felt sore. He couldn't remember how long it had been since he tasted eggs. It's vaguely like last year's Dragon Boat Festival, when my father was not disabled, my mother was not crazy, and there was still some warmth from fireworks in the house.
He swallowed in small mouths and ate very slowly. The warm porridge slid into his abdomen, suppressing the sourness that filled his stomach.
"Where is dad?"
"I went to the Yamen to testify." Mother took the empty bowl and said calmly, "After the slave status was abolished and the evidence of the Zhao family's crimes was exposed, the government reopened the old case. The unjust case of your father being injured by the Zhao family was also uncovered."
"Can he bear it?" Lin Tianxing frowned slightly.
"I went with a cane, and my neighbor was with me, so nothing will happen."
Lin Tianxing nodded and hurriedly asked about the whereabouts of everyone in the mine: "Have they all escaped, Lao Suntou and Dazhu?"
The mother was silent for a moment, then her tone became serious: "Sun Laizi, Li Dazhu, and Widow Zhao all escaped safely. Only old Sun Tou did not come out."
"Didn't come out?"
"When the fire was at its worst, he had obviously rushed to the side door and escaped." The mother's voice was hoarse. "No one knew why. He suddenlyThen he turned around and rushed back into the sea of ​​fire, whining and roaring, no one could stop him. Finally, he was completely consumed by fire. "
Lin Tianxing closed his eyes.
The old man who had been speechless for twenty years suddenly emerged clearly. Squatting at the door of the shack, he used gravel to prop up a broken earthen pot to cook wild vegetable soup; when he was seriously injured and had a high fever and fell into coma, it was those rough hands that fed him spoonfuls of water to sustain his life, forcibly pulling him back from the gate of hell.
After twenty years of slavery in the mines, his tongue was mutilated and he was trampled on and never had any dignity.
Who can understand his final choice?
Is it the only old thing that you can’t bear to part with for half your life? Was he suddenly freed, but at a loss? Or have you really had enough? Suffering has crushed all expectations, and for him, death may be the only relief.
Lin Tianxing opened his eyes, suppressed the soreness in his eyes, and asked no more questions. There is a heavy feeling in the chest, which makes people feel stuffy.
He stood up and got off the ground, his legs and feet felt temporarily weak, but he regained his strength after walking a few steps. Scanning the room, he was slightly surprised. Grain and dry firewood were piled in the corner, and half a knife of bacon hung on the stove beam. In the past, his family would not even dare to expect such supplies during the New Year.
"Where did these things come from? "
"Not sure. "My mother shook her head. "When I opened the door early yesterday morning, the things were placed at the door. There was no note. Several poor families in the alley received supplies inexplicably. Some people get rice, some get fish, and some get new shoes. The person who delivers the thing never shows up, just puts it down and leaves. "
Lin Tianxing was stunned for a moment, suddenly enlightened.
The whole city knew that the Zhao family had fallen, and everyone knew that he had torn away the fig leaf of the powerful at the risk of his life and death. These people who quietly delivered things were ordinary people making a living in the market. They couldn't protect justice, but they were willing to use their own thoughts to support the young man who stood up for them.
They didn't want to leave their names for fear of getting involved, but they sent it quietly anyway. This little bit of warmth may seem humble, but it's as hot as a ball of fire.
He walked to the door and looked at the neighbors passing by in the alley. Someone caught a glimpse of him and just nodded slightly. There are no unnecessary pleasantries, and there is no deliberate pursuit. Only those who have gone through hard times together can understand the silent understanding. Each other has gone through the same hardships, no need to say more, we all understand.
At this moment, Lin Tianxing was completely convinced. Shen Qing's life was not lost in vain.
